Located near Colorado State University, accessible via Prospect Road exit from I-25
Family-friendly yet challenging escape room experiences

Maximum 6 players in Midnight in Wonderland
Games include small spaces and low clearance; guests with mobility challenges may not access all areas but can play if one team member can access them

blurb: Guests have 60 minutes to find clues, unlock secrets, and solve puzzles to escape the room. The experience is private and suitable for team-building, parties, and family fun. Two themed rooms are available: "Midnight in Wonderland" and "Tomb of the Forgotten."
